description: Proposed Corvi MCP mail tool definitions plus MRTR, scoped resource subscriptions, and Tasks extension metadata. This is a design/catalogue artifact, not an MCP tools/list wire response.

tools.name: mail_list_identities
tools.description: Return the complete caller-discoverable set of authorized identities, including those backed by different physical mailboxes/providers, each with independent effective permissions. Required permission: mail:identities:list. The server enforces identity and disclosure policies regardless of tool discovery.

tools.name: mail_list
tools.description: List policy-visible mail only, sorted newest first. No upstream counts. Required permission: mail:messages:list. The server enforces identity and disclosure policies regardless of tool discovery. A client may select a different authorized identityId on its next call without changing tokens; permissions do not union across identities.

tools.name: mail_search
tools.description: Case-insensitive literal query over visible subject and text. Hidden mail is never returned. Required permission: mail:messages:search. The server enforces identity and disclosure policies regardless of tool discovery. A client may select a different authorized identityId on its next call without changing tokens; permissions do not union across identities.

tools.name: mail_get
tools.description: Get a sanitized mail projection; never return raw MIME or hidden mail. Required permission: mail:messages:read. The server enforces identity and disclosure policies regardless of tool discovery. A client may select a different authorized identityId on its next call without changing tokens; permissions do not union across identities.

tools.name: mail_get_attachment
tools.description: Get approved attachment bytes as base64 with a 2 MiB decoded size cap. Required permission: mail:attachments:read. The server enforces identity and disclosure policies regardless of tool discovery. A client may select a different authorized identityId on its next call without changing tokens; permissions do not union across identities.

dataBase64.description: Base64 of permitted content; max decoded size 2 MiB

tools.name: mail_send
tools.description: Send text-only mail from an authorized identity. Require explicit user approval unless unattended automation is permitted. Required permission: mail:messages:send. The server enforces identity and disclosure policies regardless of tool discovery. A client may select a different authorized identityId on its next call without changing tokens; permissions do not union across identities.

_meta.corvi.dev/confirmation: MRTR elicitation/create required unless explicitly authorized unattended send policy

tools.name: mail_get_send_status
tools.description: Get the authorized status of one outgoing submission. Required permission: mail:submissions:read. The server enforces identity and disclosure policies regardless of tool discovery. A client may select a different authorized identityId on its next call without changing tokens; permissions do not union across identities.

subscriptions.semantics: Best-effort invalidation only for caller-visible filtered changes. No raw-message resources or hidden-only change signals.

tasks.constraints: Per-request extension opt-in, durable handle before response, per-read reauthorization and re-filtered results, cooperative cancellation.

authorizationModel.identityDiscovery: mail_list_identities returns all caller-visible identities with each identity's own effective permissions
authorizationModel.grantBinding: principal/credential -> identityId -> independently authorized actions and policies
authorizationModel.isolation: message IDs, cursors, attachments, send receipts, MRTR approval state, Task handles and subscription URIs must be bound to the selected identity
authorizationModel.subscriptions: one subscriptions/listen may authorize multiple independent visible-mail resource URIs from the same token
